systems.name: 3.1 Character Special Moves
systems.notes: Balance and polish Eve's Meteor Slam, Diesel's Truck, Flare's Napalm. Add visual polish and audio cues.
tasks: Eve meteor: smooth zip-off and crash sequence
Diesel truck: ripper damage tweaking, horn sound
Flare napalm: tighter spread, big shell finale
Special bar SP cost and regeneration

systems.name: 3.2 Blood Super / Desperation Move
systems.notes: Blood super at 33% HP when SP bar empty. High risk, high reward. Needs its own visual flair.

systems.name: 3.3 Super Meter & Combo Scaling
systems.notes: Implement a visible super meter that fills on hits and taking damage. Add damage scaling on long combos.
tasks: Meter gain on attack and hit taken

systems.name: 3.4 Special Move Input System
systems.notes: Support motion inputs (QCF, HCF, charge) for specials and supers. Add input display in HUD.
